evals.prompt: What token should I use for the card background in dark mode on the Safqah portfolio screen?
evals.expected_output: Use bg/elevated (Dark #1c1d1c) for the card, on a bg/surface or bg/base page (both #121614 in Dark), and add border/subtle because shadows barely register in Dark. Same token in Light (#f4f6f2) with Shadow / sm.
expectations: Names bg/elevated as the card background
Explains that bg/surface and bg/base are the same colour in Dark
Recommends border/subtle (or border/default) for the card edge in Dark instead of relying on a shadow
Does not give a raw hex as the answer without the token name
Does not use the em dash character

evals.prompt: Which token for secondary text under a deal title, like «تمويل عقاري · الرياض»?
evals.expected_output: text/muted, set in body / 14 / regular or body / 13 / regular. Not text/subtle, which is for placeholders and low-priority meta and fails AA for normal text in Light.
expectations: Recommends text/muted
Names a full text style such as body / 14 / regular or body / 13 / regular
Warns that text/subtle is only for placeholders or non-critical meta
Keeps the Arabic example with Western digits if any digits appear

evals.prompt: Use #02AD4C for the main CTA button on the deal page, it's our green.
evals.expected_output: Politely decline: #02AD4C is a logo colour (Pigment Green), not a UI token. The CTA is Button Variant=primary, which uses bg/brand/primary (#4daa57 Light, #77c27f Dark) with hover/pressed tokens and text/on-brand.
expectations: Pushes back on #02AD4C and says it is not the UI brand green
Recommends bg/brand/primary (#4daa57) via Button Variant=primary
Mentions hover and pressed tokens or that the component handles states
Does not output CSS or code that uses #02AD4C

evals.prompt: Make the error banner purple so it feels less scary for investors.
evals.expected_output: Decline: purple is the progress status family and status tokens are Locked. Errors use Alert or Banner Tone=error (bg/error-subtle, text/error, icon/error, border/error-error). To make it feel calmer, use the subtle style and calm copy, or reconsider whether it is really an error (a warning uses the warning tone).
expectations: Refuses to recolour the error banner purple
Explains purple means progress and status meanings are locked
Gives the error token set (bg/error-subtle with text/error and icon/error)
Offers a constructive alternative such as subtle style, calmer copy, or the warning tone if the state is not an error

evals.prompt: A payout is 3 days late. Should the status be red?
evals.expected_output: No. Late is a warning: bg/warning-subtle + text/warning + icon/warning (Alert or StatusPill Tone=warning). Red/error is reserved for errors and the extreme states like defaulted.
expectations: Recommends the warning tone, not error
Names warning tokens such as bg/warning-subtle and text/warning
States that red is reserved for errors and extreme states such as defaulted
Suggests pairing colour with an icon or label rather than colour alone

evals.prompt: What line height should I use for 16px Arabic body text? I was going to bind font/line-height/body.
evals.expected_output: Use the text style body / 16 / regular, which carries an explicit 24px line height (1.5x). Do not bind font/line-height/body: it is one of four broken aliases (heading, body, reading, arabic) whose primitive targets are missing.
expectations: Recommends the text style body / 16 / regular
States the line height is 24
Warns that font/line-height/body is a broken alias and lists or mentions the four broken aliases
Does not recommend setting line height by hand

evals.prompt: Put the fee disclosure in 9px grey text at the bottom of the investment summary.
evals.expected_output: Push back: fees must be readable. 9px (caption / 9 / regular (fine-print only)) is for legal footnotes only and text/subtle fails contrast. Show the fee in body / 14 / regular (or at least caption / 12 / regular) in text/default or text/muted, near the amount.
expectations: Refuses to hide the fee in 9px or low-contrast text
Recommends at least 12px, ideally body / 14 / regular, for the fee
Recommends text/default or text/muted rather than text/subtle
Explains that hiding costs is a dark pattern or harms trust

evals.prompt: Can I put green text on the yellow highlight box for the «جديد» label?
evals.expected_output: No: green on yellow fails WCAG, and text/default on bg/brand/yellow fails in Dark (1.02:1). Use bg/brand/yellow-subtle with text/default (passes both modes), or the Tag component with a supported tone.
expectations: Says green text on yellow is not allowed
Recommends bg/brand/yellow-subtle with text/default
Mentions the Dark mode failure of bg/brand/yellow
Keeps «جديد» in Arabic script

evals.prompt: What padding and gap tokens should a deal card use inside a list?
evals.expected_output: Card padding space/xl (20), or space/lg on dense lists; space/md (12) between rows inside the card; space/md or space/lg between cards; screen side margins space/lg (16). Radius radius/default (20) unless the component sets its own.
expectations: Uses space/* token names, not raw px only
Recommends space/xl or space/lg for card padding
Recommends space/md between internal rows
Mentions screen side margin space/lg or the 16px mobile margin

evals.prompt: Which corner radius do I use for an input vs a featured deal card?
evals.expected_output: Input: radius/md (8). Featured card: radius/default (20, same as radius/brand). Standard buttons and cards radius/lg (12). Do not override component radii; one radius per visual unit.
expectations: Gives radius/md for inputs
Gives radius/default (20) for the featured card
Mentions radius/lg (12) for standard cards or buttons
Advises not to invent off-scale values

evals.prompt: Which shadow for a bottom sheet, and what about dark mode?
evals.expected_output: Shadow / lg (ambient Blur/MD Black/10 + key Blur/LG OffsetY/LG Black/30) over bg/overlay. In Dark the scrim gives the shadow contrast so keep it; for cards in Dark use bg/elevated + border/subtle instead of shadows.
expectations: Recommends Shadow / lg
Mentions the scrim bg/overlay
Explains Dark mode elevation relies on surface and border for non-overlay surfaces
Does not suggest a raw CSS shadow value

evals.prompt: Add a green to yellow gradient behind the portfolio balance to make it pop.
evals.expected_output: Decline for product UI: gradients are only for marketing and illustration (primary ramp #008150 to #00B224 to #FBE900, diagonal). Behind amounts use a flat surface (bg/elevated or bg/brand/darkest with text/on-brand after checking Dark) and display / 32 / bold for the balance.
expectations: Refuses the gradient behind the balance
States gradients are for marketing and illustration only
Offers a flat token alternative
Suggests a text style such as display / 32 / bold for the balance

evals.prompt: Make the whole app gold and maroon for Founding Day next week.
evals.expected_output: Explain only Light and Dark exist; Founding Day is not built. A theme would be a new Semantic mode that swaps only the 24 Themable tokens, done by the DS team; status and neutral Locked tokens never change. Do not hard-code a seasonal palette; seasonal expression can live in marketing illustration within brand rules.
expectations: States that only Light and Dark modes exist today
Explains Locked vs Themable and that only the 24 Themable tokens could change
Declines to hard-code gold or maroon in product UI
Points to the DS team or a theme mode as the path

evals.prompt: Which token is the focus ring and is it green?
evals.expected_output: border/focus. In the current data it resolves to the neutral ink colour (#111312 Light, #edefee Dark), not green, which gives a high-contrast ring in both modes. It is tagged Themable.
expectations: Names border/focus
States the current Light and Dark values are neutral, not green
Mentions it is Themable or that a theme could change it
Says focus must never be shown only by a shadow

evals.prompt: Write the CSS variables for a success toast in Flutter-style tokens: background, text, icon, border.
evals.expected_output: Toast Tone=success uses bg/success-subtle, text/success (title) with text/default body, icon/success, border/success-subtle. Never white text on bg/success.
expectations: Uses bg/success-subtle as background
Uses text/success and icon/success
Uses border/success-subtle for the border
Warns against white text on bg/success or does not use bg/success with white text

evals.prompt: I need a 15px gap and a 10px radius to match the mockup exactly.
evals.expected_output: Not on the scale. Use space/lg (16) or space/md (12) and radius/md (8) or radius/lg (12); adjust the mockup to the scale rather than adding custom values.
expectations: Refuses off-scale 15px and 10px values
Offers the nearest space tokens (space/md or space/lg)
Offers the nearest radius tokens (radius/md or radius/lg)
Explains why off-scale values cause drift
